title: Cochain and homotopy presentations of scalar reduction agree
statement: For the actual completed-to-finite coefficient projection on any scheme in the coefficient universe, any normalized DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel has derived functor naturally isomorphic to the prescribed scalarReductionDerivedExtension. No point-sections comparison or reduction-unit normalization is assumed.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: The two ordinary extension functors have identical prescribed changeOfRings objects and maps. Their object equalities give a natural isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: Precompose the prescribed homotopy universal counit with the full essentially-surjective homotopy quotient. The structured-arrow precomposition is initial, so its pointwise right Kan extension is unchanged. Transport through quotientCompQhIso and the ordinary extension isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change; principal quotient specialization of the original item proof

proof.text: Both derived functors are now left derived functors of the same cochain functor along Q. Apply Functor.leftDerivedUnique, with the counits in the correct order.

theorem scalarReductionCochainModel_iso (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 2, u + 2}
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (O := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
      (S := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)
      (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E Y n)) :
    Nonempty (M.T ≅ scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n)
